title: commander: rename Option.hidden to hiddenFromHelp across modules
prompt: This is a copy of commander.js (lib/ and index.js). The Option class records whether it is hidden from help in a property called `hidden`. Rename that property to `hiddenFromHelp` everywhere under lib/ that defines or reads it (the Option class and the help generation). Keep unchanged: the `hideHelp()` method name, `Command._hidden`, and the `{ hidden: true }` / `noHelp` settings objects accepted by `.command()` and `.addCommand()`, which are public API and must keep working. Behaviour must not otherwise change.
